title: incident-bot: on-call autodiagnostics & slo-toolkit integration (v2)
author: Maya Chen
description:
Background: The on-call runbook flow was missing contextual SLO burn diagnostics and richer links to runbooks. This made it slower for engineers to triage incidents and increased time-to-ack for outages. Motivate: Integrate the slo-toolkit utilities directly into incident-bot diagnostics, add a compact on-call helper that surfaces the most-likely SLO owner, recent burn-rate windows, recent relevant errors from logs, and direct runbook links. This PR is the second iteration (v2) after the initial autopilot prototype (ENG-1823).

What changed (high level):
- incident-bot: Add a new diagnostics pipeline that calls slo-toolkit to compute short/medium/long burn windows and returns a ranked list of probable SLO owners.
- incident-bot: Add on-call helper commands ("/ibot diagnose" and "/ibot quick-links") that return compact summaries for Slack and PagerDuty messages.
- slo-toolkit: Add a lightweight HTTP client wrapper and a new endpoint (slo-toolkit/api/v1/diagnostics) that returns JSON summary (burn rates, contributing services, candidate runbooks).
- Runbooks: Hook into existing runbook registry to attach canonical links; add fallback heuristics when exact match is missing.
- Tests: Unit tests for the new utilities and integration tests that exercise the Slack command flow (local mocks).
- Docs: Updated docs/incident-bot/diagnostics.md with examples and sample output.

Why this approach: Tightening the diagnostics path reduces context-switching for the on-call engineer. By ranking probable owners and surfacing runbooks with confidence scores we expect a measurable reduction in mean time to acknowledge (MTTA) and mean time to resolve (MTTR) for SLO-related incidents.

Compatibility and migration: Backward compatible with existing incident-bot commands. The slo-toolkit endpoint is optional; if unavailable incident-bot falls back to previous heuristics. No data migrations required.

CI and rollout notes: CI had a flaky integration test related to mock Slack rate limits; a rerun passed (see CI checks). Rolling deploy: feature gated under runtime flag `diagnostics.v2` with gradual rollout (5% -> 25% -> 100%).

Next steps (follow-ups):
- Add a telemetry metric tracking how often suggested runbooks are clicked (ENG-1887).
- Surface confidence thresholds to SRE dashboard and tie to auto-escalation policy.
